# Protein (`protein` v1)

A protein (UniProt): length, mass, domains and where it acts.

**Group:** Genomics and biology · **Mnemonic:** `PROT` · **Identifiers:** `PROT-…` in `proteinId`

Open one with `PROT <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: protein
version: 1
description: "A protein (UniProt): length, mass, domains and where it acts."
match: { kind: protein, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Genomics and biology · Protein, id: $.proteinId }
strip:
  - { label: Protein, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Accession, bind: $.accession, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Length (aa), bind: $.length, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Mass (kDa), bind: $.massKda, fmt: price2 }
  - { label: Location, bind: $.subcellular }
panels:
  - id: domains
    kind: table
    title: Domains and regions
    key: F2
    rows: $.domains
    columns:
      - { label: Region, bind: "@.name" }
      - { label: Start, bind: "@.start", fmt: amount0 }
      - { label: End, bind: "@.end", fmt: amount0 }
  - id: function
    kind: kv
    title: Function
    area: right
    rows: $.function
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.gene, 'gene')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
